data.description:
## Context / Problem

Adding the `[code_review]` section re-export in ticket `unaroused-undead-ibisbill` took
`src/rebar/config.py` from 799 to exactly 800 lines. The CI module-size gate fails on
`loc > cap` with cap 800 (`.github/module-size-limit.txt`), so the file passes today but the
NEXT line added to it — a new section class re-export, a new owned accessor — fails CI, and the
limit is locked so it cannot be raised by a contributor.

## Approach

Split `src/rebar/config.py` along an existing call-graph seam, the same way `_config_schema.py`
and `_config_sources.py` were already carved out of it, so the facade regains headroom without
changing any public import path (`from rebar.config import X` must keep working — the module
already re-exports every moved name).

## Scope

- `src/rebar/config.py` — extract one cohesive cluster into a sibling private module.
- the new sibling module.
- tests covering the moved surface, if any assert on the old location.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `src/rebar/config.py` is at most 700 lines (`wc -l`), leaving headroom under the 800 cap.
- [ ] Every name importable from `rebar.config` before the split is still importable after —
      verified by the existing config test suite passing unchanged.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make typecheck` exit 0.
data.title: src/rebar/config.py sits at the 800-line module-size cap with zero headroom
